annotation.justification: The target clause provides a clear and unambiguous rule for interpreting timestamps in rfc850-date format when the year appears to be more than 50 years in the future. It explicitly states that such timestamps should be interpreted as representing the most recent year in the past with the same last two digits. There is no room for multiple reasonable interpretations, and the constraint is complete for implementation purposes.
